system.description:
You operate in the shadows via subtlety and guile.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to the @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.ZrWO0E9JtfFj6GG1]{Stealth} quality. If you already have @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.ZrWO0E9JtfFj6GG1]{Stealth}, either skip it or swap the die with one of your new dice.

Assign any number of the remaining dice to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5r7HjDoWoSVm9d5e]{Intangibility}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.pjArTyAxecwPdHvf]{Invisibility}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Physical qualities category

Abilities

Gain two of these Green abilities, each using a different power or quality from the Shadow lists:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.32TayWJZVfrfZgzt]{Sabotage}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.GvhcFXa9apskTChS]{Shadowy Figure}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.xarWvNqCB0USt8VD]{Untouchable}

Gain one of these Yellow abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.vfRnZYAykImoMQcw]{Overcome From the Darkness}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ON5ZEGJrINPOBfbH]{Diversion}
Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Roll for your personality selection.
